name: @vibress/lms
description: Vibress LMS domain foundation and provisional Host Member storage pilot; not production ready

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run prepare:pilot && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.lint: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters --noImplicitReturns && node --check test/domain.test.mjs && node --check test/lifecycle.test.mjs && node --check test/host-operations.test.mjs && node --check test/pilot-extension.test.mjs && node --check scripts/prepare-pilot-release.mjs && node --check src/acceptance/live-host.mjs && node --check scripts/verify-live-host.mjs && node --check test/live-host-acceptance.test.mjs
scripts.release:pilot: npm run build && npm run prepare:pilot
scripts.verify:local: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
